spans.s:
† 1. लुठ् लुठ्, i. 1, Par. To knock down.
 --i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To oppose.
 2. To suffer pain.
 3. To go.

2. लुठ् लुठ्, i. 10, Par., and लुण्ठ् लुण्ठ्, † रुण्ठ् रुण्ठ्, i. 1, Par. To rob.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लुण्ठित.
 1. Plundered, robbed,

; 427.
 2. Peeled (?), Pañc. 121, 11 (cf. my transl. n. 790).
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, निर्लोठित, Robbed,
. To roll upon the ground, to welter,

. To move to and fro, Hit. ii. d. 67.
 4. To agitate, to touch, Bhāg.

. Ptcple of the pf. pass. लुठित, Rolling on the ground. m. A horse's rolling on the ground.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, निर्लुठित, Rolled down,

.
 --With प्र प्र, To roll on the ground, Pañc. 254, 22.
 --Caus. प्रलोठित, Rolling, heaving, tossing.

लुठ् + अन, n.
 1. A horse's rolling himself on the ground.
 2. Rolling on the ground with sorrow.
